content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The infrastructure you choose determines the success of your digital business. When platforms like Gumroad and Stripe fail, you need an alternative solution that provides end-to-end control over your payment and delivery pipeline. NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers offer a trusted solution that gives you full ownership of your infrastructure, eliminating the risk of platform downtime, delayed payouts, and restricted access to certain countries.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers, you need to have a basic understanding of Cloudflare Workers, GitHub Pages, and NOWPayments. You'll also need to set up a Cloudflare account and create a new project on Cloudflare Pages. Additionally, you'll need to create a NOWPayments account and obtain your API keys. Make sure to familiarize yourself with the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments, and is a great starting point for building your digital commerce infrastructure.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you need to create a new Cloudflare Worker script that will handle incoming webhooks from NOWPayments. You'll also need to configure your NOWPayments account to send webhooks to your Cloudflare Worker script. In this pipeline, you can use Supabase to store order information and Google Drive to deliver your digital products. This setup will ensure that you receive timely payments and deliver your products efficiently.
NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers offer a reliable infrastructure for digital creators to receive crypto payments and deliver their products efficiently.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

The fee structure of NOWPayments is fundamentally different from conventional platform fees. NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction. There is no monthly fee, no setup fee, no payout fee, and no minimum transaction volume requirement. Network fees for the underlying blockchain transaction are paid by the buyer and vary by network — Tron fees are under $0.10, Solana fees are fractions of a cent, Bitcoin fees average $1 to $5 for most transactions. For a $97 product sold through the Sovereign Starter Stack, the total transaction cost is approximately $0.49 to NOWPayments plus network fees typically under $0.10 on Tron. Compare this to Gumroad's 10% fee on the same transaction — $9.70.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your digital business grows, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to handle increased traffic and transaction volume. To do this, you can use Cloudflare's built-in scaling features, such as load balancing and autoscaling. You can also use NOWPayments' advanced features, such as customizable webhooks and payment gateways. By scaling your infrastructure, you can ensure that your digital business continues to grow and thrive.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

The most important question you're likely asking is, 'How long does it take to set up NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers?' The answer is, it's a straightforward process that can be completed in a few hours. Simply create a new Cloudflare Worker script, configure your NOWPayments account, and set up your payment and delivery pipeline. With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you can have your digital commerce infrastructure up and running in 48 hours.
By using Supabase to store order information and Google Drive to deliver digital products, you can ensure that your payment and delivery pipeline is secure and efficient.

Additionally, consider investing in the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments and provides a comprehensive solution for digital commerce infrastructure.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers, follow these steps: create a new Cloudflare account and project on Cloudflare Pages, set up a NOWPayments account and obtain your API keys, create a new Cloudflare Worker script that handles incoming webhooks from NOWPayments, configure your NOWPayments account to send webhooks to your Cloudflare Worker script, test your infrastructure thoroughly before processing live transactions, and process your first transaction and verify that it was successful.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I receive USDT payments on Tron?

To receive USDT payments on Tron, you need to set up a NOWPayments account and configure it to send webhooks to your Cloudflare Worker script. You can then use Supabase to store order information and Google Drive to deliver your digital products.
How do I convert Bitcoin to naira using P2P exchanges?

To convert Bitcoin to naira using P2P exchanges, you need to set up a P2P exchange account and configure it to send and receive payments in Bitcoin and naira. You can then use NOWPayments to receive payments in Bitcoin and convert them to naira using the P2P exchange.

The advantages of using NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers include end-to-end control over your payment and delivery pipeline, customizable webhooks, and advanced payment gateways. This setup also eliminates the risk of platform downtime, delayed payouts, and restricted access to certain countries.
How do I scale my infrastructure to handle increased traffic and transaction volume?

To scale your infrastructure, you can use Cloudflare's built-in scaling features, such as load balancing and autoscaling. You can also use NOWPayments' advanced features, such as customizable webhooks and payment gateways.
What is the cost of using NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers?

The cost of using NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers is 0.5% per transaction, with no setup fees or subscription charges. This makes it an affordable solution for digital creators looking to receive timely payments for their digital products.
